condition_rule: Inherit common_conditions and add claim conditions.

claims.conclusion: Intent notification and reason are optional; termination may occur without advance notice.
UE shall present intent notification with any supplied reason; actual-termination notification is optional, including any supplied reason if presented.

conditions: Service includes request for more information in intent notification
claims.conclusion: UE must respond; inclusion of remaining amount of data is optional.

limitations: 仅覆盖 Stage1 通知义务；不列举完整终止条件，不规定请求编码、响应超时或延长是否获准。
